scripts.build: bun ../scripts/dev-env.mjs sync --profile=development --target=frontend --quiet && NODE_ENV=development VITE_RUNTIME_ENV=dev CRAWLER_DEBUG=true vue-tsc -b && NODE_ENV=development VITE_RUNTIME_ENV=dev CRAWLER_DEBUG=true vite build --mode development
scripts.build:watch: bun ../scripts/dev-env.mjs sync --profile=development --target=frontend --quiet && NODE_ENV=development VITE_RUNTIME_ENV=dev CRAWLER_DEBUG=true vite build --watch --mode development
scripts.build:prod: bun ../scripts/dev-env.mjs sync --profile=production --target=frontend --quiet && bun ../scripts/dev-env.mjs check --profile=production --target=frontend --quiet && NODE_ENV=production VITE_RUNTIME_ENV=prod vue-tsc -b && NODE_ENV=production VITE_RUNTIME_ENV=prod vite build --mode production && bun scripts/clean-dist.cjs
scripts.lint: bun run format && bun run eslint && bun run stylelint
scripts.lint:check: bun run eslint:check && bun run stylelint:check
scripts.eslint: eslint . --no-cache --fix --max-warnings 0 --fix-type problem,suggestion,layout && echo '✅ ESLint: 所有问题已修复'
scripts.stylelint: stylelint "src/**/*.{css,vue}" --no-cache --fix && echo '✅ Stylelint: 所有问题已修复'
scripts.test:smoke: bun run build && bun run test:service-worker:e2e
